desc: Case 1: Standard Key-Ordered Concurrency & Out-of-Order Completion with Watermark Jump
input:
WORKERS 4 MAX_IN_FLIGHT 8
RECORDS 5
0 A 200 0
1 B 20 0
2 C 30 0
3 A 50 0
4 D 40 0
END

EXECUTION_ORDER: 1@20,2@30,4@40,0@200,3@250

HOLES_PREVENTED: 3

BENCHMARK: SEQ=340ms PAR=250ms SPEEDUP=1.36x
